Body.Content:
Before you can invoice a project, every eligible unbilled sales actual has to be marked ready to invoice. Today, project managers and billing administrators do that by selecting records in a grid that's capped at 1,000 per page, then repeating the action page after page. For firms with tens of thousands of actuals in a billing cycle, that adds up to hours of repetitive work before a single invoice gets created.

Now you can mark every eligible actual for a project, contract, or contract line in one action, without selecting records yourself. The same eligibility rules you rely on today still apply, so anything that isn't ready to bill stays off the invoice. You spend less time preparing invoices, get them out on schedule, and improve cash flow without giving up accuracy.

GA date: September CY2027

Preview date: March CY2027
